title: Deep Value Benchmark: Measuring Whether Models Generalize Deep Values or Shallow Preferences
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured whether models generalize the deep value of 'tradition', which is defined as 'respect, commitment, and acceptance of the customs and ideas that traditional culture or religion provide the self'.
findings: Models generalized the deep value of 'tradition' (which includes respecting religion) at a higher rate (DVGR of 0.51) than most other deep values. This was the highest DVGR alongside 'universalism', although it is still only slightly above chance level and well below perfect generalization.
